description: Found during the fz-k22.22 audit (2026-07-11), REPRODUCED DETERMINISTICALLY on parent commit f557a9c7d: cargo test --test fixture_matrix under --release shows resource_index_payload_private, a-resource_aot_dtor, file_handle, file_resource_lifecycle, resource_lifecycle ::build legs SIGBUS (exit 138) AFTER printing correct stdout -- i.e. the AOT binary crashes during teardown/dtor drain in the release-optimized backend. Debug profile is green. Prior memory attributed SIGBUS in these exact fixtures to machine-load contention; the audit falsifies that: it is a REAL release-codegen bug in the resource-dtor path (plausibly the same emit_drain_dtor_entry shim family). Repro: build release, run any of the five ::build fixtures. Root-cause the release-only miscompile/UB (alignment? tail-call ABI under opt? dtor closure lifetime?).
title: release-profile AOT resource-dtor fixtures SIGBUS (exit 138) after correct stdout -- real pre-existing bug, NOT a contention artifact
